entities.summary: JeemTV, formerly known as Al Jazeera Children's Channel, is a Qatari Arabic-language pay television channel, aimed at children between the ages of 6 and 12. It was previously co-owned by Al Jazeera Media Network and the Qatar Foundation from launch until June 2013, when Al Jazeera fully acquired the channel. It was then acquired by beIN Media Group on 1 April 2016.
